_comment: Single source of truth for the product catalog. Category pages, pagination, counts, JSON-LD, sitemap-products.xml and the WP-import CSV are all generated from this file by tools/build-products.mjs — never edit site/products*.html by hand. A product belongs to multiple categories by listing them in `categories` (first entry = primary, used for ordering and the card's main label). status: "real" ships to WordPress later; "placeholder" is local test data only and must NOT be imported.

categories.label: Waterproof Light
categories.blurb: IP-rated housings, sealed optics and touring-ready output for outdoor stages.
categories.title: Waterproof Stage Lights — IP65 Outdoor Lighting Fixtures | MOKA LITE
categories.description: IP65 waterproof moving heads, beams and washes for outdoor concerts, festivals and open-air installations. Sealed optics, die-cast housings and tour-ready rigging from MOKA LITE.

categories.label: Beam Light
categories.blurb: Tight aerial beams with fast movement, sharp gobos and high-impact stage presence.
categories.title: Beam Lights — Moving Head Beam Fixtures for Stage & Tour | MOKA LITE
categories.description: High-intensity beam moving head lights with narrow angles, fast pan/tilt and crisp gobos for concerts, clubs and touring rigs. Explore MOKA LITE beam fixtures.

categories.label: Wash Light
categories.blurb: Smooth color mixing and even field coverage for clubs, theaters and event venues.
categories.title: Wash Lights — LED Moving Head Wash & Zoom Fixtures | MOKA LITE
categories.description: LED wash moving heads with smooth RGBW/CMY color mixing, wide zoom ranges and even field coverage for stages, theaters, churches and live events.

categories.label: Laser Light
categories.blurb: Precise laser effects for programmed shows, DJ sets and immersive installations.
categories.title: Laser Lights — RGB Animation Lasers for Shows & Clubs | MOKA LITE
categories.description: Professional RGB animation laser lights with ILDA/DMX control for concerts, nightclubs, DJ shows and immersive installations. Precision scanners from MOKA LITE.

categories.label: Kinetic Light
categories.blurb: Motion-driven fixtures for dynamic ceiling rigs and synchronized show moments.
categories.title: Kinetic Lights — Moving LED Winch & Lifting Ball Systems | MOKA LITE
categories.description: Kinetic lighting systems — DMX winches, lifting LED balls and motion-driven fixtures for dynamic ceilings, stage shows and architectural installations.

categories.label: Effect Light
categories.blurb: Special effect fixtures that add texture, sparkle and atmosphere to live scenes.
categories.title: Effect Lights — Strobes, Blinders & Special FX Fixtures | MOKA LITE
categories.description: Stage effect lights including strobes, blinders and atmospheric FX fixtures that add texture and impact to concerts, clubs and live productions.

categories.label: Par Light
categories.blurb: Compact PAR fixtures for reliable uplighting, truss washes and stage fills.
categories.title: LED Par Lights — Uplighting & Stage Wash PAR Cans | MOKA LITE
categories.description: Compact LED PAR lights for uplighting, truss washes and stage fills — indoor and IP65 outdoor versions for weddings, events and permanent installs.

categories.label: LED Dance Floor
categories.blurb: Modular LED dance floor systems with durable panels and event-ready visuals.
categories.title: LED Dance Floors — Modular Interactive Floor Panels | MOKA LITE
categories.description: Modular LED dance floor panels with durable tempered-glass surfaces and pixel-mapped visuals for weddings, clubs, exhibitions and event rentals.

categories.label: LED Screen
categories.blurb: Rental-ready LED screen modules for stage backdrops and branded content.
categories.title: LED Screens — Rental LED Video Wall Panels for Stages | MOKA LITE
categories.description: Indoor and outdoor rental LED screen panels for stage backdrops, concerts and branded events. Fine-pitch, quick-lock cabinets from MOKA LITE.
